title: Auto Loans: cancelling GAP waiver coverage and the GAP refund
content:
# Auto Loans: cancelling GAP waiver coverage and the GAP refund

This policy of the Auto Loans product category at PCB governs cancelling GAP waiver coverage on an auto loan and the refund of the GAP charge. Each product applies its own GAP availability, GAP charge, full-refund window, cancellation fee and proration method.

## Clauses

1. **Optional coverage.** GAP waiver coverage is optional and may be cancelled by the borrower at any time while the loan is open.
2. **Borrower's decision.** Cancelling is the borrower's own decision, recorded through a GAP cancellation request that the borrower confirms.
3. **Full refund inside the window.** A GAP cancellation within the product's full-refund window, in calendar days after the loan funded, refunds the whole GAP charge.
4. **Pro-rata refund after the window.** After the window, the refund is the GAP charge multiplied by the number of whole months remaining to the scheduled maturity date, divided by the term in months, rounded half-up to the cent, less the product's cancellation fee. No refund is made when that figure is zero or less.
5. **Early payoff.** Paying the loan off early with GAP in force is treated as a cancellation on the payoff date.
6. **One refund per loan.** Each loan receives at most one GAP refund, judged from the loan's recorded refunds.
7. **Where the refund goes.** The refund is paid to a PCB checking account of the borrower, where it is deposited, or by official check. It is never applied to the loan balance.

## Counting the full-refund window

- Clock start: the funding date on the loan record.
- Count calendar days with the day after the funding date as day 1.
- The full refund applies when the cancellation date is **on or before** the funding date plus the window; the last day of the window still qualifies.

## Boundary case (illustrative window of 30 days, not a product value)

| Funded | Cancellation date | Refund basis |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-04-01 | 2026-05-01 (day 30) | whole GAP charge |
| 2026-04-01 | 2026-05-02 (day 31) | pro-rata, less the fee |

## Pro-rata cases (illustrative charge 600.00 and fee 40.00, not product values; 60-month term)

| Whole months remaining to maturity | Charge multiplied by months, divided by term | Less the fee | Refund |
|---|---|---|---|
| 37 | 370.00 | 330.00 | 330.00 |
| 3 | 30.00 | a figure below zero | none |

**Wrong reading:** "the cancellation fee is also taken from a cancellation inside the window." **Correct basis:** inside the window the whole GAP charge is refunded; the fee is deducted only from the pro-rata refund after the window.
